sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Plated Minimalist Nath – Sparkling White Stone Studded
sourceNotes.rawContent: Radiate elegance with this exquisite gold-toned white stone nath. This high-fashion accessory features a delicate drop design, perfect for weddings and festivities. To maintain its brilliant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely in a dry place after every wear.
